correctness.rationale: An input with s original runs loses exactly s−1 symbols, and deletions can never increase run count, so n≥m+r−1. Increasing every noninitial output run by one gives the canonical unique minimum preimage; appending arbitrary alternating singleton original runs pads it to any n≥minimum. Counting q(q−1)^(r−1) binomial(m−1,r−1) outputs yields the finite formula. Composition and cumulative generating functions yield the rational expression; its Perron root gives the rate. Independent full direct image enumeration for q=2 up to n=10 and q=3 up to n=7 agreed with the formula.

final_claim: For the deterministic threshold-one contextual deletion map deleting the first symbol of each noninitial original constant run, every nonempty output with m symbols and r runs has a unique minimum-length preimage of length m+r−1 and occurs at every longer block length. Thus exact M_q(n) is the run-weighted sum with rational generating function qz/((1−z)(1−z−(q−1)z²)) and asymptotic base (1+√(4q−3))/2.
